Plot an anovakit result

Source: R/class-anovakit.R
plot.anovakit_fit.Rd

Returns one of the ggplot2 objects the analysis built. The available names are listed by print() and stored in x$plots.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'anovakit_fit'
plot(x, which = 1L, ...)

Arguments

x

An anovakit_fit object.

which

Name or index of the plot. Defaults to the first one.

...

Ignored.

Value

A ggplot2 object, invisibly returning NULL when the fit holds no plots.

Examples

set.seed(1)
d <- data.frame(g = rep(c("a", "b", "c"), each = 20), y = rnorm(60))
fit <- anova_welch(d, "y", "g")
p <- plot(fit, which = "means")
